notes: Chat and Comments now use one common attempt state. Each request receives an overlay-lifetime token, and a completion is published only while the same token is still the active loading attempt.

A failed or null result exposes the existing retryable error state. Starting a retry supersedes the earlier attempt; removing a visible box deletes its state, so a late completion cannot recreate the box or overwrite the retry.

The common tests force failure, retry, a stale success from the prior attempt, a current success, a removed box, and a null translation. The architectural contract binds both product overlays to that reducer.

This closes the shared product-state gap for a recoverable translator failure and one retry. It does not claim a real provider outage, offline translation, exhaustive provider failures, or renewed visual comparison.
No backend, credentials, device data, CI configuration, or existing runtime evidence was modified.

The candidate was rebased onto main #544. Translator runtime, test and contract blobs are anchored at productSha; 25/25 focal contracts plus Wasm, Android and iOS x64 affected targets passed after the rebase, without repeating unrelated E2E matrices solely for the new SHA.
